name: Hermes-4-405B
notes: Llama-3.1-405B architecture (LlamaForCausalLM, hidden 16384, 126 layers, 128 query heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128 explicit, rope_theta 500000). Note gqa_ratio = 128 / 8 = 16, the most aggressive KV compression in this slice: the same KV cost per token as a 16x-compressed MLA-style layout achieved with plain GQA. README documents ~5M samples / ~60B tokens of post-training data and a hybrid reasoning mode. KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 126 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 516096 B/token = 504.0 KiB/token. At 128k context that is 63.00 GiB of KV per sequence at bf16, against 811.75 GB of bf16 weights - so at long context weight quantisation alone buys nothing back unless the KV cache is also quantised or the context is offloaded; the KV cache is the scarce resource here, not the weights. context_scaling is null: context length is native to the pretrained config, no rope_scaling.
